name: elven silk
protection_note: Woven in the golden wood, light as a leaf: it slows an edge and catches a point.
protection_price: Catches fire, and fire scorches it.
lore_descriptor: lighter than a moth's wing and catches starlight even underground
first_pickup_chronicle: Found elven silk from Lothlórien. Tolkien had the Galadhrim send hobbits off in their gifts, and the hobbits came home. I will take the endorsement.
